text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tosen Jordan—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that a Paka Petit? Omg, adorbs! 
Totally hyped~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Tosen Jordan is pointing, I 
see a claw machine filled with plushies 
inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not that I'm into it or anything, but 
like, if there was a City one, I'd kinda 
want it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"And then we line it up next to mine~ 
Wait, isn't that insanely cute? It's so 
soothing~"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But, like, I suck at this kinda thing. 
...Guess it's a no-go. If I get hooked, my 
allowance is gone. And there's a lipstick 
I totally want this month~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she said that, Tosen Jordan kept 
glancing over at the game. She clearly 
hasn't given up on it. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously? You look like you'd suck at 
this, but... Well, if you're willing to do 
it, I'll leave it to you~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm gonna take a video of ya. Don't 
go lookin' lame, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
